project.name: Generic Pipeline and Workflow Components Framework
project.description: A reusable Python framework that provides programmatic contracts, reusable component implementations, composition capabilities, and specialization mechanisms for constructing Stage and Step components and their associated Processing Units and optional Supporting Units. It defines the internal behavior and composition responsibilities of these components, and provides the Stage contract, Stage behavior, and integration mechanisms needed to make a GPWCF Stage usable as an executable Node within a selected external workflow framework. GPWCF does not own or implement the consuming workflow's pipeline orchestration and does not presume a universal adapter or integration abstraction across workflow frameworks.

provides: Programmatic contracts and reusable implementations for Stage and Step components
Stage-level composition capabilities for coordinating Steps within a Stage
Step-level composition capabilities for selecting, associating, invoking, and coordinating Processing Units and optional Supporting Units
Specialized contracts and execution-result models for Processing Units and Supporting Units
Common architectural coordination contracts for component association and lifecycle responsibilities
Component integration capabilities that enable specialized implementations to participate in their owning composition boundaries
The Stage programmatic contract, Stage behavior, and integration mechanisms required to expose a GPWCF Stage as an executable Node within a selected external workflow framework
Composition and specialization mechanisms that preserve component-specific responsibilities without prescribing a universal execution topology
Generic behavioral contracts, guarantees, and architectural constraints governing GPWCF components and their composition boundaries
consumerResponsibilities: Select and specialize the framework components and optional Supporting Unit patterns required by the consuming workflow
Provide or select concrete Processing Unit and Supporting Unit implementations that satisfy the applicable specialized contracts
Configure and compose Stage and Step components according to their actual responsibilities
Select the external workflow framework that will own pipeline orchestration and invoke GPWCF Stage components
Provide workflow-specific integration configuration and any target-framework-specific integration elements not supplied by GPWCF

Define workflow-specific execution, concurrency, cancellation, recovery, lifecycle, and reuse policies to the extent that these are not governed by the selected GPWCF contracts or the integrated workflow framework
Define workflow topology and workflow-level operational decisions without requiring GPWCF to prescribe them
exclusions: Owning, implementing, or replacing the consuming workflow's pipeline orchestration engine
Implementing the business workflow of SMRB.PayloadDescriptionGenerator
Prescribing a fixed number, arrangement, or execution topology for Stages, Steps, Processing Units, or Supporting Units
Requiring every consumer to use every framework component or Supporting Unit pattern
Imposing a universal Processing Unit registry, plugin manager, loader, or runtime orchestration mechanism
Prescribing a specific external workflow framework or defining target-specific integration mechanisms before an integration target is selected
Defining consumer-specific business logic, workflow topology, or operational policies

dependencyManagement.runtimeBundling: The framework does not own or duplicate a Python runtime. Its current implementation baseline uses the Python standard library only.
dependencyManagement.consumerIsolation: A consuming application retains ownership of its runtime and dependency environment. The framework package must not depend on the private dependency bundle of SMRB.PayloadDescriptionGenerator.
